users_server_migration_preconditions: backfill is idempotent (use upsert on (user_id, server_id, is_archived=false))
every backfilled doc is reversible (delete by (user_id, server_id, created_at))
no concurrent writes to users.server during backfill (locked UI ensures this)
server name snapshot captured at backfill time (resilient to legacy server rename)
rollback_safe_seed_requirements: phase 1: backfill with idempotent upsert + audit log of every write
phase 2: verify counts (users.server populated count == server_profiles is_archived=false count per user)
phase 3: store seed_id + timestamp in metadata for rollback
rollback: delete docs where metadata.seed_id == <id>; do not touch hand-created docs
orphan_prevention: never flip RUNTIME flag before backfill complete
if a user has users.server but seed missed -> fallback read path uses users.server until next seed
if a user has no users.server and no profile -> pre-home UI shows only Available section
